title: Sparkling Hill Full Day Guided Wine Tour with 5 Wineries
includes: Hotel & Accommodation pickup and drop off included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Welcome to the Sparkling Hill Wine Tour, visiting the most sought-after wine region in the Kelowna area. Enjoy a leisurely day meandering through the rolling hills of Lake Country while taking in world-class views along the Scenic Sip Wine Trail. 

Experience stunning vineyards, endless sunshine, and jaw-dropping architecture complete with some of the tastiest wines British Columbia has to offer. Showcasing the unique terroir of the region, relax and enjoy award-winning wines and culinary delights. Offering sensational wines, unparalleled hospitality, and breathtaking views, the wineries along the Scenic Sip wine trail are sure to impress! 

Our full-day Sparkling Hill wine tour offers tastings at 5 award-winning wineries, a lunch reservation at a stunning winery restaurant, and memories to last a lifetime!
